scope: page-scoped cases in one healthy combined PDF
privacy: Entirely synthetic; no private or real patient data.

pages.title: Clean digital baseline
pages.notes: Healthy machine-generated text with ordinary geometry.

pages.title: Clean dense ruled table
pages.notes: Dense table with clear ruling, dates, currency and totals.

pages.title: Non-embedded Base14 font
pages.notes: Standard Helvetica text without an embedded TrueType font.

pages.title: Embedded TrueType subset font
pages.notes: Embedded DejaVu Sans subset with Unicode punctuation and accented letters.

pages.title: Exact duplicate native text layer
pages.notes: The same native text is painted twice at identical coordinates.

pages.title: Cross-font near-overprint duplicate
pages.notes: A second cross-font text layer is offset by about one point.

pages.title: Partial duplicate header and footer
pages.notes: Only regional text bands are duplicated; global duplication is diluted.

pages.title: Raster drop shadow with clean native text
pages.notes: False-positive control: shadow is raster; native characters occur only once.

pages.title: Clean bold typography control
pages.notes: Bold face appears once and must not be mistaken for duplicate overprint.

pages.title: Full-page image-only scan
pages.notes: Image-only scan; Phase 4 printed OCR should recover visible scan text.

pages.title: Full-page scan with accurate invisible OCR
pages.notes: Hidden accurate native OCR is ignored; Phase 4 OCR comes from the rendered scan.

pages.title: Full-page scan with plausible wrong OCR
pages.notes: Wrong hidden native OCR must not be used; Phase 4 OCR is from the rendered page.

pages.title: Full-page scan with shifted OCR coordinates
pages.notes: Shifted hidden native OCR is ignored; Phase 4 OCR uses rendered geometry.

pages.title: Mixed native body and scan region
pages.notes: An image region exists but does not dominate the page.

pages.title: Image-dominant page with small native caption
pages.notes: A full-page image dominates even though a small native caption exists.

pages.title: Sparse native text on mostly blank page
pages.notes: Only one small native token exists; no header/footer chrome. Identified via manifest.

pages.title: Off-page hidden native text
pages.notes: Many native strings are placed beyond the left page boundary.

pages.title: White-on-white hidden native text
pages.notes: White-on-white native text is downgraded by the Phase 4 visibility probe.

pages.title: Invisible text rendering mode
pages.expected_viewer: visible page has a reference box
pages.notes: Invisible render-mode text is downgraded by the Phase 4 visibility probe.

pages.title: CropBox hides live native text
pages.notes: CropBox differs from MediaBox. Phase 3 rejects with native_page_metadata_mismatch when canonical displayed size and native page boxes disagree.

pages.title: Page rotation metadata 90 degrees
pages.notes: Page /Rotate=90. Intended native_authority accept; Phase 3 currently may reject via high_single_character_word_ratio after rotation. Soft-pass until rotation tokenisation is hardened.

pages.title: Page rotation metadata 180 degrees
pages.notes: Page /Rotate is set to 180. Soft-pass until rotation tokenisation/extraction-order handling is hardened (same class as T21).

pages.title: Small square page size
pages.notes: One document contains a much smaller page than the surrounding pages. Uses compact chrome so A4 header strings do not overflow 300pt width.

pages.title: Landscape page
pages.notes: Landscape orientation and wide coordinate mapping.

pages.title: Oversized page
pages.notes: Large engineering-style page tests fit-page, fit-width and coordinate scaling.

pages.title: Non-zero MediaBox origin
pages.notes: MediaBox and CropBox start at negative coordinates. Soft-pass until non-zero page-origin mapping is hardened for Phase 3.

pages.title: Two-column reading order
pages.notes: Native words are valid but semantic order may be ambiguous.

pages.title: Three-column reading order
pages.notes: Narrow columns challenge sequence reconstruction.

pages.title: Content-stream order differs from visual order
pages.notes: Right column is painted first in the content stream.

pages.title: Ruled table with merged headers
pages.notes: Merged headings and grouped numeric columns.

pages.title: Borderless table
pages.notes: Whitespace and alignment carry the table structure.

pages.title: Table with multi-line cells
pages.notes: Cell content spans multiple visual lines.

pages.title: Repeated header and footer content
pages.notes: Tests recognition of boilerplate versus body text.

pages.title: Ligatures and kerning
pages.notes: Contains fi/fl ligatures and ordinary repeated letters.

pages.title: Unicode NFC and NFD combining marks
pages.notes: Visually similar composed and decomposed sequences.

pages.title: Hebrew right-to-left text with numbers
pages.notes: BiDi order, punctuation and numeric fields are mixed.

pages.title: Arabic Unicode with numbers
pages.expected_viewer: Arabic code points with numeric fields
pages.notes: Exercises Arabic Unicode and directionality; shaping varies by renderer.

pages.title: Vertical CJK text
pages.notes: Characters are individually positioned from top to bottom.

pages.title: CID-backed CJK native text
pages.notes: CID font mapping and full-width digits.

pages.title: Emoji and supplementary-plane symbols
pages.notes: Tests characters outside the Basic Multilingual Plane.

pages.title: Private-use and unassigned hidden characters
pages.notes: Hidden private-use/unassigned noise; Phase 3 currently hard-rejects primarily via control/unprintable character ratios for this synthetic construction.

pages.title: Replacement-character noise
pages.notes: A high ratio of U+FFFD replacement characters.

pages.title: Symbol-only and Dingbats noise
pages.notes: Large symbol-only regions should not be trusted as prose. Uses ASCII punctuation rows (ZapfDingbats remapped to Latin under extraction).

pages.title: Excessive single-character tokens
pages.notes: Characters are separated into hundreds of single-token words.

pages.title: Superscript and subscript positioning
pages.notes: Small vertically displaced glyphs should remain attached logically.

pages.title: Extreme character spacing and kerning
pages.expected_viewer: widely spaced and tightly spaced text
pages.notes: Tests word grouping thresholds without invalid geometry.

pages.title: Mirrored native text
pages.notes: Negative horizontal scaling creates mirrored glyph geometry.

pages.title: Sheared and skewed native text
pages.notes: Text uses a shear transformation but remains readable.

pages.title: Individually rotated words
pages.notes: Word boxes and order must account for local rotations.

pages.title: Visible text rendered only as raster image
pages.expected_viewer: text is readable but not selectable
pages.notes: Raster-only visible text; Phase 4 OCR recovers printed content.

pages.title: Handwriting-like raster page
pages.notes: Synthetic cursive-like image for later handwriting routing.

pages.title: Low-resolution scan
pages.notes: Low-resolution scan routes to visual OCR; CER may be degraded (calibration only).

pages.title: Skewed photographed document
pages.notes: Simulates a phone photograph with perspective distortion.

pages.title: Bilevel fax-like scan
pages.notes: One-bit thresholding simulates fax and CCITT-style content.

pages.title: JPEG-compressed photo page
pages.notes: JPEG photo page; Phase 3 routes empty native as visual_authority/absent.

pages.title: PNG alpha transparency and soft mask
pages.notes: Transparent raster overlays sit behind clean native text.

pages.title: CMYK image rendering
pages.notes: CMYK JPEG image plus clean native labels.

pages.title: High vector-object count stress page
pages.notes: Tests renderer and parser performance without malformed syntax.

pages.title: High native character count stress page
pages.notes: Thousands of characters test safety limits and deterministic IDs.

pages.title: AcroForm fields and widget values
pages.notes: Text field, checkbox and radio buttons are interactive annotations.

pages.title: Link, highlight, note and free-text annotations
pages.notes: Viewer must expose and render several annotation types.

pages.title: Appearance-only fake redaction
pages.notes: Underlying native text remains extractable beneath a black rectangle.

pages.title: Watermark and stamp over content
pages.notes: Large rotated watermark and visible stamp.

pages.title: Barcode and QR visual content
pages.notes: Visual codes coexist with ordinary native labels.

pages.title: Truly blank page
pages.notes: Truly blank; Phase 3 routes as visual_authority/absent. blank_page is future-phase.

pages.title: Optional Content Group (layer)
pages.expected_viewer: green layer rectangle visible by default
pages.notes: A page-level optional layer is added during post-processing.

pages.title: Repeated Form XObject content
pages.notes: The same form XObject is reused many times.

pages.title: Clipped text and graphics
pages.notes: Content extends beyond a clipping path.

pages.title: Annotation-only visible text
pages.notes: Visible text is added as a FreeText annotation rather than page content.

pages.title: Marked-content ActualText mismatch
pages.expected_viewer: visible value differs from semantic replacement
pages.notes: An /ActualText replacement intentionally disagrees with the painted string.
